fieldData.meta-description: Build a webinar landing page that registers each sign-up in Zoom, shows local start times and becomes a replay page after the session.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
A registrant table you can query

Every sign-up becomes a row with the name, work email, join link and time of registration. Filter it before the session, or sync new rows to HubSpot or any CRM with an API.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-2-des: Visitors check the slot before anything else. Show the weekday, the start time and the length next to the headline, and say whether there is live Q&A. If a recording will follow, say so there for the people who cannot make it.
